t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes are in pairs, and each pairs lead to a specific forget (bright or dark). Discovering the link between these pairs and the colour of forest will help me win.

vb_textbox.text: Take a note of the hat size, sometimes bigger hats are more profitable, but then once one a big hat starts scoring lower, switch to smaller hats. For hats with equal sizes, normally one colour is better, but it can change. It normally stays consistent for at least 10 rounds or so.
